presets.title: Database meltdown
presets.blurb: Slow memory leak in the primary database. Watch it take the platform down.

presets.title: Payments crash
presets.blurb: Payments dies instantly. Can't be predicted, but the cascade can be contained.

presets.title: Cache storm
presets.blurb: Cache is overloaded. Soft dependencies degrade across half the system.

graph.note: An edge source->target means 'source depends on target': failures flow from target to source.
